data.desc: Matrix Service Company (Nasdaq: MTRX) is a leading heavy industrial contractor that engineers, constructs, and maintains critical energy, power, and industrial infrastructure. The Company's commitment to safety, quality, and integrity has earned it a leadership position in providing infrastructure solutions across multiple end markets. Matrix's work is foundational to helping energy, power, and industrial clients achieve their objectives, positively impact quality of life through the products they provide and improve the efficiency and resilience of their critical infrastructure. Matrix prides itself on its culture, its commitment to its core values, and on being consistently certified as a Great Place To Work.
